input_encoding: RGB -> 112x112 per channel -> [R,G;B,0] 224x224 amplitude -> unit optical power
oeo: after each of two phase/propagation layers: intensity -> mean normalization -> spatial LayerNorm -> LeakyReLU(0.1) -> Softsign -> unit-power coherent reload
readout: full active CCD -> adaptive average pool 16x16 -> log1p mean normalization -> LayerNorm(256)-Linear(256,64)-GELU-Linear(64,9)
selection: validation only; test is evaluated once after checkpoint selection
